final_response.summary: The baseline uses strict comparisons, excluding both boundaries. Inclusive comparisons retain every qualifying entry in input order, including duplicates, while creating a new outer list without mutation. Tests cover all requested regression categories; they were not run. Tests expect select_entries in the execution namespace.

source:
def select_entries(entries, lower, upper):
    return [entry for entry in entries if lower <= entry[0] <= upper]
